blockers.description: Kenmi tile spritesheets loaded via KENMI_CATALOG have frameWidth:16, frameHeight:16 but the frame index math in MapLoader doesn't match actual spritesheet layouts. desert-beach-tiles-1 is 80x48 (5x3=15 frames), desert-water-tiles-1 is 96x48 (6x3=18 frames), desert-grass is 48x80 (3x5=15 frames). The auto-tiling code mixes constants from different sheets.
blockers.workaround: Don't use frame indices at all. Use Phaser tileSprite or load tiles as individual images instead of spritesheets.
